# Deploy your node

## Summary

This section contains details on how to deploy and share your node.

**Source**: https://docs.n8n.io/connect/create-nodes/deploy-your-node.md

---

This section contains details on how to deploy and share your node.

## In this section

* [Submit community nodes](/connect/create-nodes/deploy-your-node/submit-community-nodes): submit your node to the community node repository, so anyone can [install and use it](/integrations/community-nodes/installation-and-management) like any other community node. This is the only way to use custom nodes on Cloud.
* [Install private nodes](/connect/create-nodes/deploy-your-node/install-private-nodes): install the node into your own n8n instance as a private node.
